prompt: Stylised 3D action-adventure game with a hand-painted gouache look and soft brush textures, bright midday sun over a dry terracotta city of aqueducts, arcades and stepped stone cisterns: a small, friendly, chunky fired-clay golem with rounded red-brown limbs and two carved eye holes climbs a sandstone wall, grabs the top ledge and pulls itself onto an empty aqueduct channel; it heaves a wooden sluice gate open and bright turquoise water gushes into the dry cistern below, lifting a floating wooden crate up toward the ledge.
